frames.slice_level: Upper thorax, at or just above the aortic arch (approximately T2-T4). Trachea round and midline; no arch contour resolved.
Carina / proximal main bronchi, approximately T5-T6. Airway seen centrally as a transverse lucency at the bifurcation.
Below the carina, at the main bronchi / bronchus intermedius, approximately T6-T7. Both bronchi visible as paired lucencies within the mediastinum.
Lower thorax at heart level, approximately T7-T8. Heart occupies most of the mediastinum; bronchus intermedius and left lower lobe bronchus visible as paired lucencies.
Lower thorax approaching the lung bases, approximately T8-T9. Heart occupies the central mediastinum; both lower lobes broadly in view.
Lung bases approaching the diaphragm, approximately T9-T10. Lung cross-sections reducing; central soft tissue is heart with diaphragm and upper abdominal contents beginning to enter the field.
Lower thorax, approximately T7-T9, comparable to the heart-level and lung-base soft-tissue frames.

cases.impression: Pulmonary edema — diffuse interlobular septal thickening, peribronchial wall thickening, and perihilar ground-glass and consolidation — with a second, separate process superimposed: multiple bilateral peripheral nodules with slight upper lobe predominance, explicitly not typical for edema, including a 9 mm left upper lobe nodule and a 9 mm right upper lobe nodule. Suspicion of a ground-glass halo around several of the nodules, possibly exaggerated by motion artefact. No cavitary lesion. This impression follows the official report, which supersedes the screenshot-derived read recorded across the six supplied frames. That read identified the septal thickening, the peribronchial changes, and the perihilar opacity but attributed all three to airway disease — bronchiectasis, aspiration, and bronchiolitis — and did not reach edema. It also called the three upper-thorax frames unremarkable and missed the nodules entirely. See official_report.read_delta for the full account of what held up and what did not.

findings.location: peripheral, both lungs, slight upper lobe predominance
